idea.title: Invoice chase
idea.text: A small tool that sends polite, escalating payment reminders for late invoices on the freelancer's behalf, by email and text, and shows who owes what.

weakest.reason: Several reminder tools already exist.
No data on how many freelancers chase late invoices.
Late payment hurts but is occasional.

suggestion.title: Start with design and marketing agencies
suggestion.rationale: Agencies chase dozens of late invoices a month, so reminders save them the most time.

evidence.title: Source
evidence.quote: Design and marketing agencies chase an average of 40 late invoices a month.

suggestion.title: Free for up to five clients, paid above
suggestion.rationale: The main rival has no free tier, so a free entry plan lowers the cost of trying it.

evidence.title: Source
evidence.quote: Rival charges 29 dollars per month flat with no free tier.

idea.title: Fridge watch
idea.text: A cheap temperature sensor for small restaurants that logs the fridge temperature every 5 minutes and alerts the owner's phone when it rises above a safe limit.

weakest.reason: Many vendors sell temperature loggers.
Small restaurants rarely budget for monitoring.
The saving from avoided spoilage is not quantified.

suggestion.title: Sell through food-safety insurers
suggestion.rationale: Insurers that discount premiums for logged cold-chain records give kitchens a reason to pay.

evidence.title: Source
evidence.quote: Insurers in two states cut premiums for kitchens with logged cold-chain records.

idea.title: Habit pets
idea.text: A habit tracker where each habit grows a virtual pet that gets sick when you skip days. Aimed at students preparing for exams.

weakest.reason: Students may drop habit apps after exams.
Habit trackers with game mechanics are common.
Demand peaks only in exam season.

suggestion.title: Pilot with exam-prep teachers who set habits for a class
suggestion.rationale: Teachers see students drop revision after week three, so a class-wide pet gives them a tool to hold the habit.

evidence.title: Source
evidence.quote: Prep teachers say students drop daily revision after week three.
